doc.state: index into connecting, uninitialized, initializing, off, disabled, floating, servoing, fault
doc.source: arm motion source in force: index into none, hold, track, servo, pose, home, stow, chunk (none = not servoing)
doc.phase: of the planned motion (servo / pose / home / stow / chunk): index into none, executing, settling, reached, not_reached, done, aborted, preempted
doc.j<i>_q: output encoder (xout): the arm's measured pose
doc.j<i>_q_cmd / qd_ff: position command and the MIT velocity reference (track: the twist's joint velocity while fresh; planned motions: the trajectory's) (NaN when not servoing)
doc.j<i>_acc_lim: 1 if the acceleration limit held back an increase of this joint's commanded speed this tick
doc.j<i>_e_mot: q_cmd - q_mot: the error the motor's MIT loop sees
doc.j<i>_tau_est: kp*e_mot + kd*(qd_ff - qd) + tau_g: torque the MIT law applies
doc.j<i>_tau_g: gravity feedforward (whenever the motors are on)
doc.j<i>_status: Damiao status code (1 enabled, 0 disabled, >= 8 fault)
doc.x..qw: TCP pose from the output encoders, arm base frame (quaternion x, y, z, w)
doc.err_pos / err_rot: measured TCP vs commanded TCP (output side)
doc.goal_err_pos / rot: commanded TCP vs the goal of the source
doc.w / w_lin / sigma_min: manipulability sqrt(det(J J^T)) of the 6x6 TCP Jacobian, of its translational rows, and its smallest singular value, at the measured pose
doc.limited: the joint speed limit held q_cmd back this tick (the step limit)
doc.read_age: age of the reading this tick used: 0 normally; > 0 when replies were missed and the latest complete reading was kept (fault beyond 50 ms with the motors on)
doc.read_misses: ticks with missed replies since the node started (per motor in /state)
doc.twist_age: s since the track twist feedforward was written (NaN if none)
doc.g_gap / g_gap_cmd / g_gap_goal: jaw gap measured / sent this tick (after the force limit) / goal (m)
doc.g_force: squeeze force estimated from the gripper's MIT law (N)
doc.J<r><c>: jacobian channel: TCP Jacobian at the measured pose, base-frame axes (LOCAL_WORLD_ALIGNED), row r of [vx vy vz wx wy wz], column = joint
